# Do Not Edit Files — Brickyard Operations Hub

## Purpose

This document lists all files in the `FieldOps2/` directory that must **not** be manually edited. Editing these files by hand can corrupt the Power Apps solution, break the Azure DevOps sync pipeline, or cause data loss when the solution is re-exported from Power Apps Studio.

**All changes to Power Apps source must be made in Power Apps Studio, then exported via the Azure DevOps pipeline.**

---

## Absolute Do Not Edit

These files are auto-generated by the Power Platform toolchain on every export. Any hand edit will be overwritten on the next export or will cause import failures.

|---|---|

| `FieldOps2/BrickyardSharePointOperations/canvasapps/new_fieldops2_6938b/new_fieldops2_6938b_DocumentUri/Controls/4.json` | Internal control ID map; auto-generated by Studio; do not touch |

## Do Not Edit Without Careful Review

These files can technically be edited, but doing so incorrectly will break the solution. Only make changes here as a last resort when Studio cannot make the change, and only for the specific properties noted.

| File | Safe to change | Do not change |
|---|---|---|
| `FieldOps2/BrickyardSharePointOperations/solutions/BrickyardSharePointOperations/solution.yml` | `Version` number (increment on publish) | `UniqueName`, `Publisher`, `SolutionPackageVersion`, `languagecode` |
| `FieldOps2/BrickyardSharePointOperations/canvasapps/new_fieldops2_6938b/new_fieldops2_6938b_DocumentUri/Src/App.pa.yaml` | Minor property corrections explicitly allowed by the canvas apps YAML warning header | Control trees, connection references, screen structure |
| `FieldOps2/BrickyardSharePointOperations/canvasapps/new_fieldops2_6938b/new_fieldops2_6938b_DocumentUri/References/DataSources.json` | Nothing — let Studio manage this | Connection GUIDs, metadata JSON, CdpRevision tokens |

## Why These Files Must Not Be Hand-Edited

### YAML Source Files (`Src/*.pa.yaml`)
Power Apps YAML source (`.pa.yaml`) is generated by Studio and is documented as **preview-only** for minor edits. The official warning embedded in every generated file reads:

> *"YAML source code for Canvas Apps should only be used to review changes made within Power Apps Studio and for minor edits (Preview). Use the maker portal to create and edit your Power Apps."*

Hand-editing YAML can:
- Corrupt control tree references that are tracked by GUID in `Controls/*.json`
- Break the `.msapp` binary that is the actual deployable artifact
- Cause import failures in the Power Platform CLI

### Connection Reference Files (`canvasapp.yml`, `DataSources.json`)
These files contain environment-specific GUIDs (connection IDs, environment IDs, tenant IDs). Editing them by hand will cause the app to reference non-existent or incorrect connections after import.

### Solution Metadata (`solutioncomponents.yml`, `rootcomponents.yml`, `missingdependencies.yml`)
These are output artifacts from the Power Platform solution packager. They describe the state of the solution at the time of export. They are regenerated on every export and must not be edited manually.

### Publisher File (`publisher.yml`)
The publisher is tied to the organization GUID (`org1e88e961`). Changing this will cause the solution to be treated as belonging to a different publisher, which can block deployment to the target environment.

---

## Enforcement

Before committing any changes under `FieldOps2/`, confirm:

1. The change was made in **Power Apps Studio** (or Power Platform CLI), not by hand in a text editor
2. The change was exported via the Azure DevOps pipeline export process
3. The commit message indicates which Studio action produced the change (e.g., "Export after adding ProjectsScreen")
4. No files in the **Absolute Do Not Edit** list above were modified by hand

If you discover a hand-edited file in a PR, reject it and request that the change be made through Studio instead.
